text: Chapter 3: Battle with the Ancient God@Fate of the Fortress
■Next Mission\nStart from Figo at Figo's Manor.
Let's back up the soldiers at Ethos Fortress that lies to\nthe south of Figo's Manor!
Let's go to find a Resistle person who can create the holy\ngems to cure the poison!

Let's collect the materials of the detox gem and
ask Naiata to create it!

You can get [Jagged Fang] from Gob Roga, [Saham Crystal]
from Rotta Nemico in Saham Underground Cave, and
[Spiritual Gem] from Cassy in Ancient Empress's Tomb.
Let's deliver the detox gems to Balsette at Ethos Fortress!
[[N]]Go to Ethos Fortress from Figo's Manor.
[[N]]Ask Naiata to create the gems in Saham Underground Cave.
[[N]]Give the materials to Naiata at Saham Underground Cave.
[[N]]Deliver the detox gems to Balsette at Ethos Fortress.
